name: Hybrid scenario
description: Named actors, operations, campaigns, infrastructure, instruments and events combining military, cyber, informational, political, economic, intelligence or proxy activity.

entity_types.label: State actor
entity_types.description: A specifically named state authority or state organization conducting or directing hybrid activity.

entity_types.label: Intelligence agency
entity_types.description: A specifically named civilian or military intelligence organization.

entity_types.label: Security service
entity_types.description: A specifically named internal-security, counter-intelligence or state-security organization.

entity_types.label: Proxy organization
entity_types.description: A specifically named organization explicitly described as acting on behalf of, under the influence of or with material support from another actor.
exclude_when: Do not infer proxy status solely from ideological alignment or unverified allegations.

entity_types.label: Proxy group
entity_types.description: A specifically named informal or non-state group explicitly described as operating as a proxy.

entity_types.label: Front organization
entity_types.description: A specifically named organization explicitly identified as concealing, representing or facilitating another actor's activities.

entity_types.label: Influence organization
entity_types.description: A specifically named organization whose identified function includes coordinated political, social or informational influence.

entity_types.label: State media outlet
entity_types.description: A specifically named media organization formally owned, controlled or operated by a state.

entity_types.label: Covert media outlet
entity_types.description: A specifically named media outlet explicitly identified as concealing its controlling or sponsoring actor.

entity_types.label: Influence-linked think tank
entity_types.description: A specifically named research or policy organization explicitly connected to a hybrid influence activity.

entity_types.label: Proxy non-governmental organization
entity_types.description: A specifically named non-governmental organization explicitly identified as being directed, financed or used as an intermediary by another actor.

entity_types.label: Private military company
entity_types.description: A specifically named private military or security company involved in deniable, indirect or combined activity.

entity_types.label: Cyber threat group
entity_types.description: A specifically named intrusion set, advanced persistent threat or cyber-threat actor.

entity_types.label: Hacktivist group
entity_types.description: A specifically named group conducting politically or ideologically motivated cyber activity.

entity_types.label: Troll farm
entity_types.description: A specifically named organization or coordinated facility operating deceptive online personas at scale.

entity_types.label: Bot network
entity_types.description: A specifically named or distinctly identified coordinated network of automated or semi-automated accounts.

entity_types.label: Coordinated account network
entity_types.description: A specifically named or distinctly identified cluster of online accounts acting in coordination.

entity_types.label: Cyber operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named offensive, disruptive, espionage or preparatory cyber operation.

entity_types.label: Information operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated operation using information to influence perceptions, behavior or decision-making.

entity_types.label: Psychological operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named psychological operation or coordinated perception-management operation.

entity_types.label: Covert operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named operation explicitly described as concealing the identity or responsibility of its sponsor.

entity_types.label: Influence operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated operation intended to influence political, social or institutional outcomes.

entity_types.label: Sabotage operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated operation intended to damage, disable or disrupt physical or digital systems.

entity_types.label: Economic pressure operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated operation using trade, finance, energy, investment or market access as coercive instruments.

entity_types.label: Political interference operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated operation intended to covertly alter political or institutional processes.

entity_types.label: Election interference operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated operation targeting an election, referendum or electoral institution.

entity_types.label: Border pressure operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated operation using border activity, migration flows or controlled incidents for coercive purposes.

entity_types.label: Hybrid operation
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated operation explicitly combining multiple military and non-military instruments.

entity_types.label: Disinformation campaign
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated campaign distributing false or misleading information.

entity_types.label: Propaganda campaign
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated campaign promoting a political, ideological or strategic narrative.

entity_types.label: Influence campaign
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated campaign intended to shape opinions, behavior or policy.

entity_types.label: Online harassment campaign
entity_types.description: A specifically named or distinctly identified coordinated campaign targeting individuals or organizations with online harassment.

entity_types.label: Narrative campaign
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated campaign centered on disseminating and reinforcing an identifiable strategic narrative.

entity_types.label: Lawfare campaign
entity_types.description: A specifically named coordinated campaign explicitly using legal or regulatory mechanisms for strategic pressure.

entity_types.label: Sanctions-evasion network
entity_types.description: A specifically named or distinctly identified network used to evade sanctions or export restrictions.

entity_types.label: Influence-financing network
entity_types.description: A specifically named or distinctly identified network financing political, informational, cyber or proxy activity.

entity_types.label: Covert procurement network
entity_types.description: A specifically named or distinctly identified network used to acquire controlled goods, technology or services.

entity_types.label: Smuggling network
entity_types.description: A specifically named or distinctly identified network moving goods, people, funds or equipment outside lawful channels.

entity_types.label: Shell company
entity_types.description: A specifically named company explicitly identified as lacking substantial independent operations and used as an intermediary.

entity_types.label: Cover company
entity_types.description: A specifically named company explicitly identified as concealing intelligence, military, procurement or influence activity.

entity_types.label: Operational cryptocurrency address
entity_types.description: A specifically observed cryptocurrency address linked by evidence to a hybrid operation, campaign or network.

entity_types.label: Operational financial account
entity_types.description: A specifically identified financial account linked by evidence to hybrid activity.

entity_types.label: Malware family
entity_types.description: A specifically named malware family used in a hybrid or state-linked operation.

entity_types.label: Exploit tool
entity_types.description: A specifically named software tool or exploit framework used in a hybrid operation.

entity_types.label: Surveillance software
entity_types.description: A specifically named spyware or surveillance platform used in political, intelligence or coercive activity.

entity_types.label: Command-and-control infrastructure
entity_types.description: A specifically identified digital infrastructure used to control malware, accounts or coordinated cyber activity.

entity_types.label: Covert communication channel
entity_types.description: A specifically named or identified communication service or channel used to coordinate concealed activity.

entity_types.label: Propaganda outlet
entity_types.description: A specifically named publication or media organization explicitly identified as a propaganda outlet.

entity_types.label: Operational messaging channel
entity_types.description: A specifically identified social-media or messaging-platform channel linked to a hybrid operation or campaign.

entity_types.label: Operational social account
entity_types.description: A specifically identified social-media account participating in a coordinated hybrid activity.

entity_types.label: False online persona
entity_types.description: A specifically identified online identity explicitly determined to be fabricated or deceptively operated.

entity_types.label: Leak platform
entity_types.description: A specifically named website, service or channel used to publish stolen, manipulated or strategically released information.

entity_types.label: Influence portal
entity_types.description: A specifically named online portal used as part of a coordinated influence activity.

entity_types.label: Targeted critical infrastructure
entity_types.description: A specifically named infrastructure system targeted, exploited or leveraged in a hybrid operation.

entity_types.label: Targeted energy infrastructure
entity_types.description: A specifically named energy network, pipeline, grid or system involved in coercion, disruption or strategic pressure.

entity_types.label: Targeted telecommunications infrastructure
entity_types.description: A specifically named telecommunications network, cable or communications system involved in hybrid activity.

entity_types.label: Border infrastructure
entity_types.description: A specifically named border-management system, crossing network or barrier involved in hybrid pressure.

entity_types.label: Influence event
entity_types.description: A specifically named conference, forum, protest or public event explicitly organized as part of a coordinated influence activity.

entity_types.label: Cyber incident
entity_types.description: A specifically named or uniquely identified cyber incident associated with wider political, military or coercive activity.

entity_types.label: Sabotage event
entity_types.description: A specifically named or uniquely identified sabotage event.

entity_types.label: Election-interference event
entity_types.description: A specifically named or uniquely identified interference event affecting an electoral process.

entity_types.label: Hybrid border incident
entity_types.description: A specifically named or uniquely identified border event associated with coordinated political or coercive pressure.

entity_types.label: Attribution report
entity_types.description: A specifically named report attributing a cyber, influence, sabotage or covert activity to an actor.

entity_types.label: Hybrid-threat report
entity_types.description: A specifically named analytical report concerning hybrid threats, actors or operations.

entity_types.label: Leaked dataset
entity_types.description: A specifically named or distinctly identified leaked collection of data used in or resulting from a hybrid activity.

entity_types.label: Sanctions program
entity_types.description: A specifically named sanctions regime or restrictive-measures program used in strategic pressure or response.

entity_types.label: Foreign influence program
entity_types.description: A specifically named continuing program intended to build or exercise political, cultural, economic or informational influence.

entity_types.label: Hybrid-threat resilience program
entity_types.description: A specifically named program designed to detect, resist or respond to hybrid threats.

entity_types.label: Hybrid-security agreement
entity_types.description: A specifically named agreement concerning cooperation against cyber, information, economic or other hybrid threats.

entity_types.label: Information-sharing agreement
entity_types.description: A specifically named agreement for sharing threat, intelligence, cyber or security information.
